message: macro `sameArity` declares two rules taking 1 arguments
notes: a rule-form macro selects its rule by ARITY (macro-system.md MAC-LANG-14), so the second rule of a repeated arity can never be reached
help: give the rules different parameter counts, or merge them

message: macro `spread` takes 1 or 3 arguments, but was given 2
notes: a rule-form macro selects its rule by ARITY (macro-system.md MAC-LANG-14): the rules are tried in order and the first whose parameter count matches wins, so an invocation matching none is this refusal rather than a fall-through
help: pass as many arguments as one of the macro's rules declares parameters
